=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:23655 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The guard `if [ "${EXTFIN_DELIVERY_OUTCOME}" != "drift" ]; then` after the `esac` is always true (dead code), because the `drift` arm and all other non-completion arms end in `continue`.
  WHY: Behaviour is unchanged, but the guard suggests `drift` can fall through and nests the completion block one level deeper than needed (all reviewers rated it NIT).
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:6300-6322 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: `external_finalize_delivery_check` sets `drift`/`content_check_unavailable` before the default-branch lookup, fetch and `merge-tree`, so a failed content check stays `drift` instead of `unverified`.
  WHY: A transient failure clears `final_merge_pr`, opens a fresh final PR and posts a comment saying the commits have not reached the default branch, with no evidence. It is self-correcting and fail-closed, and all reviewers rated it NIT.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "The completion comment and the tracking-issue security-pass block never claim a passed audit for a SHA that was not delivered to the default branch."
  expected_change_site: scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh external-finalize `drift` state transition (security-pass block rendered in scripts/orchestrate_lib.py)
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  EVIDENCE: The drift transition (scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh lines 23588-23593) clears `final_merge_pr` and sets `final_merge_status`/`final_merge_error` but leaves `security_pass_status` and `security_pass_head_sha` unchanged, and scripts/orchestrate_lib.py lines 1360-1365 keeps rendering "passed" with the undelivered tip. Severity disagreement: anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 rated it NIT with confidence 3 (the audited tip becomes the new final PR head, and the SHA-recording part is optional). The others rated it MAJOR, and the highest is MAJOR.
- requirement: Acceptance criterion 1: "`final_merge_pr` is cleared and a fresh final PR is requested for `A..B`."
  expected_change_site: tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py `test_external_finalize_holds_completion_when_integration_branch_advanced_after_merge` (lines 8899-8903)
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  EVIDENCE: The test asserts `final_merge_pr != 395` and checks the SHAs in `final_merge_error` only inside `if latest["final_merge_pr"] is None:`, with no unconditional `is None` or `final_merge_status == "pending"` assertion. Severity disagreement: google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite rated it MAJOR (confidence 4), the others NIT (confidence 3). The highest is MAJOR. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 notes the test does assert `final_merge_status == "pending"`, while qwen_qwen3_7-plus says it does not.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:~23655 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The `if [ "${EXTFIN_DELIVERY_OUTCOME}" != "drift" ]; then` guard is always true, because the `drift`, `diverged|unverified` and default arms all `continue`.
  WHY: It does not change behaviour. It suggests `drift` can fall through and nests the completion block one level deeper than needed.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:`external_finalize_delivery_check` | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: `drift`/`content_check_unavailable` is set before the default-branch lookup, fetch and `merge-tree`, so a failure leaves `drift`. The comment then says the commits "have not reached" the default branch.
  WHY: A transient failure makes the poller clear `final_merge_pr` and open a final PR with no evidence of drift. It is self-correcting and fail-closed.
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: "The completion comment and the tracking-issue security-pass block never claim a passed audit for a SHA that was not delivered to the default branch."
  Expected change site: the `drift` transition in scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh (rendering in scripts/orchestrate_lib.py)
  Evidence of absence: The drift jq write does not touch `security_pass_status` or `security_pass_head_sha`. The audited tip becomes the new final PR's head, so only the status-block wording is wrong in the interval. The issue marks SHA-recording as optional, and the editor deferred it.
  SEVERITY: NIT | ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 3
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: Acceptance criterion 1: "`final_merge_pr` is cleared and a fresh final PR is requested for `A..B`."
  Expected change site: `test_external_finalize_holds_completion_when_integration_branch_advanced_after_merge` in tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py
  Evidence of absence: The SHA assertions sit inside `if latest["final_merge_pr"] is None:`, which is always taken, so the conditional adds no coverage and would hide a regression. The test does assert `final_merge_status == "pending"`.
  SEVERITY: NIT | ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 3
- HARDENING_SUGGESTIONS: In `external_finalize_delivery_check`, default the outcome to `unverified`/`content_check_unavailable` and set `drift` only when `merge_rc` is 0 or 1 and the trees differ (2-3 lines). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:23655 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The `if [ "${EXTFIN_DELIVERY_OUTCOME}" != "drift" ]; then` block is dead code, because the preceding `case` ends every branch with `continue`.
  WHY: Execution never reaches the line, which misleads maintainers into thinking `drift` can fall through. A closing note rates it NIT.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:6307-6322 | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: Transient failures in the default-branch lookup, fetch or `merge-tree` are classified as `drift` instead of `unverified`.
  WHY: The orchestrator clears the final PR and opens a fresh one for drift that may not exist, causing churn and spurious PRs.
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: "The completion comment and the tracking-issue security-pass block never claim a passed audit for a SHA that was not delivered to the default branch."
  Expected change site: scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh, the external-finalize `drift` state transition.
  Evidence of absence: The drift transition does not clear `security_pass_status` or `security_pass_head_sha`, so the renderer still treats the undelivered tip SHA as "passed".
  SEVERITY: MAJOR | ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: Acceptance criterion 1: "`final_merge_pr` is cleared and a fresh final PR is requested for `A..B`."
  Expected change site: tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py, `test_external_finalize_holds_completion_when_integration_branch_advanced_after_merge`, lines 8899-8903.
  Evidence of absence: The test uses conditional assertions (`if latest["final_merge_pr"] is None:`) and lacks explicit unconditional assertions that `final_merge_status` becomes `"pending"`.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR | ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
- HARDENING_SUGGESTIONS: Set `EXTFIN_DELIVERY_OUTCOME="unverified"`/`content_check_unavailable` by default and switch to `drift` only after a successful comparison shows drift (~5 lines). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
- NOTES: The `unverified` path correctly uses `external_finalize_delivery_alert_sig`, so the earlier consensus finding is incorrect and counts as satisfied. The dead-code finding is a NIT.
=== END FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:~23655 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: After the `continue` added to the `drift)` arm, the post-`esac` `!= "drift"` guard is unconditionally true, because only `delivered`, `delivered_by_content` and `branch_deleted` reach it.
  WHY: The completion decision is not wrong, but the guard misleads readers into thinking `drift` can fall through, and it nests the completion block one level deeper than intended.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:~6307-6322 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: `drift`/`content_check_unavailable` is set before the default-branch lookup, second `git fetch`, `rev-parse` and `merge-tree`, so any failure leaves `drift` instead of `unverified`.
  WHY: The drift comment states the commits have not reached the default branch and opens a fresh final PR, without distinguishing "verified not delivered" from "could not verify". It self-heals on the next tick.
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: "The completion comment and the tracking-issue security-pass block never claim a passed audit for a SHA that was not delivered to the default branch." (Linked Issue #7611, Acceptance criteria, final bullet.)
  Expected change site: scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh, the external-finalize `drift` arm (security-pass block rendered by the reconcile machinery documented in agents.md).
  Evidence of absence: The drift arm persists `.final_merge_pr = null`, `.final_merge_status = "pending"` and `.final_merge_error` but never clears `security_pass_status` or `security_pass_head_sha`. The drift body adds "The security pass audited `${_orch_extfin_audited}`.", and the test asserts `security_pass_head_sha == tip` and that line in `drift_bodies[0]`, pinning the pass to the undelivered tip. The "optionally record the SHA" sentence is optional but the acceptance criterion is not.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR | ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: Acceptance criterion 1: "`final_merge_pr` is cleared and a fresh final PR is requested for `A..B`."
  Expected change site: tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py, `test_external_finalize_holds_completion_when_integration_branch_advanced_after_merge` (~lines 8899-8903; the body was refactored into `_external_finalize_diverged_dedupe_checks`).
  Evidence of absence: The test asserts `final_merge_pr != 395` and runs the SHA assertions only inside `if latest["final_merge_pr"] is None:`. A regression to another PR number would pass, and nothing unconditionally asserts `final_merge_status == "pending"`.
  SEVERITY: NIT | ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 3
- HARDENING_SUGGESTIONS: Default to `unverified`/`content_check_unavailable` and switch to `drift` only after `git merge-tree` returns 0 and the merged tree differs from the default tree (~6 lines). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:6300-6318 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The check sets `drift` before verifying the default-branch contents, so a failed default-branch resolve or fetch, or an unexpected `merge-tree` error, leaves `drift`.
  WHY: The drift handler clears `final_merge_pr` and says the commits have not reached the default branch, although delivery was not verified. A transient failure is treated as confirmed drift instead of being retried as unverified.
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: "The completion comment and the tracking-issue security-pass block never claim a passed audit for a SHA that was not delivered to the default branch."
  Expected change site: scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh, external-finalize drift state transition; scripts/orchestrate_lib.py security-pass rendering.
  Evidence of absence: The drift transition at scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh lines 23588-23593 leaves `security_pass_status` and `security_pass_head_sha` unchanged. The renderer at scripts/orchestrate_lib.py lines 1360-1365 keeps displaying `Status: passed` and the audited integration SHA, which has not been delivered.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR | ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
=== END FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===
